work1.paragraph1: For [[FEDACV]] we designed a modern, accessible corporate website that centralizes calendars, regulations, licenses, results, and news.
work1.paragraph2: Its digital goal was to deliver clear, reliable, and always up-to-date information for drivers, clubs, officials, and fans, streamlining procedures and improving communication across the community.
work1.paragraph3: The interface prioritizes structure and usability to navigate extensive technical content while projecting a robust identity that blends professionalism with passion for motorsport.

work2.paragraph1: For [[Santiago Sevillano Studio]] we created an elegant, highly visual English-language website that organizes its multidisciplinary team and portfolio.
work2.paragraph2: The digital objective was to be both a living archive and a professional communications tool: scalable, easy to update with new work and awards, and optimized for search engines and international markets.
work2.paragraph3: The result is a sober, contemporary digital identity that reflects the studio’s holistic approach—design, innovation, and creative direction—and clearly conveys its capability and ambition.

work3.paragraph1: For [[Clínica Navarro Viana]] we proposed a digital presence that showcases its concept of natural beauty tied to health, prevention, and personalized treatments, backed by medical rigor, cutting-edge technology, and a multidisciplinary team.
work3.paragraph2: The aim was to make information on its specialties easy to access, highlight leadership in combined procedures and strengthen patient trust by emphasizing its fully equipped operating theater and central location.
work3.paragraph3: The site guides conversion with clear access to call to actions, pricing, projecting a warm, expert, and trustworthy image consistent.

work4.paragraph1: For [[Espai Mariameta]] we created a warm, empathetic website to present their portfolio, explain their philosophy, and build trust through transparency.
work4.paragraph2: The digital goal was to communicate who they are and how they work with clarity and a human tone, encouraging contact with potential clients.
work4.paragraph3: The platform favors simple, visual navigation, with projects presented through carefully curated imagery and first-person copy, friendly typography, neutral colors, and a responsive experience.

work5.paragraph1: For [[GG STUDIO]] we designed a clean, professional website that organizes services, R&D lines, and a categorized portfolio with clear calls to action.
work5.paragraph2: Its digital objective was to consolidate a presence aligned with their method—strategy, innovation, and respect for the environment—enable fluid navigation for clients and collaborators, and strengthen SEO for architecture and sustainable innovation.
work5.paragraph3: The result is a sober, scalable digital identity that communicates technical rigor, global vision, and architectural character.
